name: Sonic / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. Three compact low air-pressure pulses followed by a clean falling hollow ringing wobble. Physical sonic shock dissipation, sparse and tonal, no electric crackles.
